items.name: animated-dropdown
items.title: Animated Dropdown
items.description: A composable, accessible dropdown menu built on Base UI with a spring-driven shared hover highlight and origin-aware scale/fade enter-exit animation.

items.name: circular-dock-menu
items.title: Circular Dock Menu
items.description: A circular trigger button that fans items out in a radial arc with spring animations.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: Component for magnetic-button

items.name: dot-orbit-shader
items.title: Dot Orbit Shader
items.description: Animated multi-color dots orbiting their cell centers. Supports up to 10 colors with controls for size, spread, and motion. Powered by Paper Design Shaders.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: The `Accordion` component allows you to toggle the visibility of content sections. It is useful for FAQs, menus, and more.

items.name: spinning-text
items.title: SpinningText
items.description: The `SpinningText` component is a dynamic and visually engaging UI element that animates text in a circular spinning motion. It is highly customizable, allowing you to control the animation's speed, direction, radius, and more.

items.name: bubble-up-button
items.title: BubbleUpButton
items.description: The `BubbleUpButton` component provides an interactive button with a fluid "bubble-up" animation effect when hovered. It creates an engaging user experience with minimal effort.

items.name: fan-view
items.title: Fan View
items.description: A trigger button that spreads labeled cards into a fanned arc layout with staggered spring animations.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A scroll-velocity marquee with seamless loop math, eased hover pause, vertical/horizontal direction, ResizeObserver-based copy count, and full prefers-reduced-motion support.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: RippleButton
items.description: An interactive button with a ripple effect for modern UIs.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card with a radial spotlight glow that follows the cursor.

items.name: animated-dialog
items.title: Animated Dialog
items.description: A composable, accessible dialog modal built on Base UI Dialog with custom direction-aware slide and fade animations powered by Framer Motion.

items.name: animated-button
items.title: Animated Button
items.description: A button layout component that animates width shifts during content changes, transitions label swaps, and supports an iOS-style hover text-swap effect.

items.name: vertical-tab
items.title: VerticalTab
items.description: The `VerticalTab` component is a versatile and interactive UI element designed for creating vertical tabbed navigation. It provides a smooth user experience with dynamic indicator transitions and customizable styles.

items.name: animated-switch
items.title: Animated Switch
items.description: An interactive iOS-style squish switch built on Base UI Switch primitives, morphing the thumb on press and translating it with a snappy physics-based spring.

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: ExpandableTabs
items.description: The `ExpandableTabs` component is a dynamic and interactive UI element designed for creating horizontal tabbed navigation.

items.name: mesh-gradient-shader
items.title: Mesh Gradient Shader
items.description: A flowing composition of animated color spots shaped by organic distortion and vortex effects. Powered by Paper Design Shaders.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: LinkPreview
items.description: The `LinkPreview` component is an interactive UI element that displays a preview of a link when hovered over. It enhances user experience by providing additional context about the link.

items.name: stagger-text
items.title: StaggerText
items.description: A text component with staggered animation.

items.name: hold-to-delete-button
items.title: Hold To Delete Button
items.description: A button that reveals a destructive fill animation while held, triggering a callback only after the full hold duration completes.
